title: Data Center & Networking Daily Briefing
description: AI fabrics and enterprise networking, data center capacity, power and cooling, and AI storage.
readFirst: Covers Oct. 23–26, and keeps the Oct. 21–22 capacity and power items because nothing newer replaced them. New on this page: the Oct. 21 WWT and DDN storage reference design for Vera Rubin campuses of 50 MW and above. No newer campus-switching release was found. No new NetApp product release was found. USFP remains the standing optics proposal.

items.headline: USFP: Cisco and NVIDIA's 400 Gb/s-per-lane pluggable, up to 12.8 Tb/s
items.summary: NVIDIA and Cisco's Oct. 12 USFP proposal is a pluggable module at 400 Gb/s per electrical lane, with a first implementation of 16 full-duplex lanes in an OSFP-sized body and a stated path past 32 lanes. They claim four times the bandwidth density of 200 Gb/s-per-lane optics and about 1.3 times the power efficiency, at up to 100 watts without a separate cooling circuit inside the transceiver. TE Connectivity and Amphenol are the named hardware partners. The design goal is to add endpoints without another switch tier.

items.headline: Google's Virgo Network is the scale-out fabric for Vera Rubin A5X clusters
items.summary: Google Cloud's Oct. 21 GTC Berlin post describes Virgo Network as a non-blocking scale-out fabric, inside a building and between buildings, using a mesh. Google says that lets an A5X cluster grow to 80,000 Rubin GPUs on one site and 960,000 across sites. Managed Lustre on A5X will support NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage so training and inference data can move by RDMA into GPU memory. GKE Managed DRANET is how Google says it will treat NICs as native Kubernetes resources on these clusters.

items.headline: NVIDIA launches Minerva, an AIOps platform for finding AI-factory failures earlier
items.summary: NVIDIA said Oct. 22 that Minerva connects telemetry from GPUs, networking, storage, schedulers, and workloads, then uses machine learning to detect anomalies, predict failures, and group related alerts into one incident. NVIDIA says it builds a knowledge graph of GPUs, SuperNICs, switches, cables, and jobs, and includes an assistant that can recommend a fix or call infrastructure APIs. IREN is using it, and Aolani, Bitdeer AI, IBM, Jio, Lambda, Quake AI, and Tesla plan to deploy it. Dell Technologies, Lenovo, and Supermicro will offer Minerva in their AI-factory operations portfolios.

items.headline: Google Cloud details Vera Rubin A5X instances; general availability next month
items.summary: A5X is a bare-metal instance on NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, announced Oct. 21, with general availability next month and additional regions for EMEA residency. Google pairs it with fourth-generation liquid cooling, Virgo networking, Managed Lustre, and a KV-cache tier meant to hold long agent context beyond GPU memory. NVIDIA's GTC notes say Ineffable Intelligence, founded by AlphaGo's David Silver, was the first customer on A5X, using it for large-scale reinforcement learning. The instance is not generally available today.

items.headline: Dell's modular data center reference design bundles compute, liquid cooling and prepared power
items.summary: Dell's Oct. 21 GTC announcement includes the Dell Modular Data Center with NVIDIA DSX as a reference design: a containerized AI factory with compute, storage, networking, rack-level power and liquid cooling, intended to connect to power that is already prepared so less integration happens on site. Dell says it will be available in early 2027. Alongside it, the PowerEdge XE9810 is described as 16 direct-liquid-cooled trays with Groq 3 language processing units for high-throughput inference, due in the first quarter of calendar 2027.

items.headline: NVIDIA says power is the AI-factory bottleneck and points customers at DSX
items.summary: NVIDIA wrote on Oct. 21 that companies are using the DSX AI Factory Platform to plan the grid and the AI factory as one system, from the substation to the rack. It said power is now the biggest bottleneck, with more than $300 billion in equipment backlogged and over 200 gigawatts of projects waiting in U.S. interconnection queues. The post says DSX Sim is for simulating the grid, substation, and factory together, and DSX Flex is for matching factory demand to grid conditions and onsite generation. NVIDIA said Hitachi Energy's battery system qualified as DSX Ready, that Phaidra's use of the controls delivered about 10 percent more compute in the same power envelope, and that Emerald AI's approach was modeled to unlock up to 100 gigawatts on the existing U.S. grid.

items.headline: OCP show floor: 800 V boards from Navitas and a 27 kW Infineon supply
items.summary: EE Times reported Oct. 16 from the OCP Global Summit in San Jose that power delivery was a main theme. Navitas showed a 24 kW, 800 V-to-12 V board developed with NVIDIA, using gallium nitride, with a 97 percent full-load efficiency target and density above 2,000 watts per cubic inch. The board converts 800 V DC to 12 V in one stage, drops the 50 V intermediate bus, and was on NVIDIA's AI Factory MGX wall. Infineon showed a 27 kW three-phase supply aimed at Open Rack V3, at 116 watts per cubic inch against a 94 watt minimum, with a 20 millisecond energy buffer, and a hot-swap controller for plus or minus 400 V and 800 V DC.

items.headline: WWT and DDN size Vera Rubin storage to more than 2.5 GB/s of read per GPU
items.summary: WWT and DDN said Oct. 21 at GTC Berlin that they have a storage reference design for AI-factory campuses of 50 megawatts and above, built to NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72 architecture and targeting more than 2.5 GB/s of read throughput per GPU. They said one 2U DDN AI400X3M is rated at 190 GB/s, which covers the 180 GB/s a full rack needs, so storage draws less power and leaves more for GPUs. For inference, DDN Infinia on NVIDIA BlueField-4 STX shares KV cache across nodes. DDN said one 112K-token test loaded that cache in 2.1 seconds versus 57 seconds to recompute, and that results depend on workload and configuration.

items.headline: Google Managed Lustre on A5X will support GPUDirect Storage
items.summary: Google Cloud said Oct. 21 that Managed Lustre will support NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage on the new A5X instances. The path is RDMA from the parallel file system into GPU memory, skipping the CPU and system memory, for training and inference data.
